skills.label: Coding Rule
skills.description: Use when implementing, debugging, or refactoring software, or making code naming and design decisions, including PHP, JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Laravel, NestJS, and APIs.

skills.label: Document Rule
skills.description: Use when creating, editing, reviewing, displaying, or exporting software documentation (specifications, plans, runbooks, ADRs, READMEs), including mixed technical and nontechnical audiences.

skills.label: Domain Driven Design
skills.description: Design or implement a Laravel module when the user requests Domain-Driven Design or the target codebase already uses that approach. Use for bounded-context modeling, domain behavior, repositories, application flows, and domain events; do not impose DDD layers on ordinary Laravel CRUD work.

skills.label: Generate Flow
skills.description: Create an evidence-backed flow document when the user asks to trace, map, document, or generate an end-to-end flow for a specific feature. Do not trigger on a generic question about how code works when no document is requested.

skills.label: Git workflow
skills.description: Load before every Git operation, including read-only checks and PR/MR tasks; require user permission to commit or push.

skills.label: React Component Generator
skills.description: Create, refactor, or improve a React component or UI block. Use when the requested work is component-level; inspect the target repository and follow its placement, styling, state, testing, and accessibility conventions rather than imposing a new stack.

skills.label: Review code
skills.description: Use when explicitly invoked as $review-code, @review-code, /review-code, or directly requested by name for backend or browser frontend review.

skills.label: Task Creator
skills.description: Draft and create a new backlog task, ticket, or issue in a task tracker or an explicitly requested local file. Use when the user asks to create, log, or file new work; do not trigger for ordinary implementation requests or updates to an existing task.

skills.label: Team Mini
skills.description: Coordinate a bounded Claude Code/Codex agent team when the user explicitly asks for team-mini or a multi-agent implementation/review workflow. Do not trigger merely because a coding task is complex.

skills.label: Testcase Creator
skills.description: Create compact, traceable end-to-end (E2E) test case suites and linked Playwright automation from approved feature evidence. Use when asked to write E2E test cases, user-flow scenarios, Playwright E2E tests, or a feature-level E2E test plan.

skills.label: Testing Rule
skills.description: Use when running, writing, reviewing, or debugging E2E tests and frontend journeys, including forms, async UI, responsive/accessibility checks, smoke/regression runs, and flaky failures. Not for unit-only testing or test case documentation alone.
